steps.message: I read the existing seam and the two files I will change. `IClock` already lives in `Billing.Abstractions`, so I inject it rather than invent a new abstraction. `SubscriptionService` has three `DateTime.UtcNow` sites; the tests construct the service with no clock today.
Applying the migration: inject `IClock` into `SubscriptionService` (with the `using Billing.Abstractions;` directive) and update the tests to use a hand-rolled `FakeClock` test double.
